effective.F3: ridge, lambda 1.0 on training-standardised [Sum a, Sum q], intercept unpenalised; refitted on each fit's training rows
effective.StatNN: F3 + LightGBM (A5.8.4; n_jobs 1) on v4 (1378 columns of the pinned pooling code on real tokens; the 18-column stand-in on synthetic tokens only) + 186 x (42 + presence); trees [100, 300, 600] chosen by mean inner L1 with seed 0 only; outer refit averages seeds [0, 1, 2]; frozen for simulation and analysis (F12b.5, F12c.1)
effective.WM-R: F3 + K+F head (1185 nominal parameters, 42 columns); output weights zero-initialised: True; residual target divided by its training-row SD per fit (prediction multiplied back): True; L1, AdamW lr 0.001 wd 0.01 batch 16, <= 300 epochs, patience 30, refit floor((e2+e3)/2); epoch selection with seeds [0, 1, 2]; refit seeds averaged; frozen for simulation and analysis (F12b.1, F12c.1)
effective.calibration: grid {0} U tau 2^(-8..12); bracket C(0) < 0.15 <= C(g*); monotonicity convex (reported, not gating); bisection to |C_cal - 0.15| <= 0.001 (<= 50 halvings) on 4000 panels 'cal:<k>:<r>:<d>'; validation on 4000 panels 'calval:<k>:<r>:<d>' within 0.02 of 0.15, else failed qualification
effective.coverage: stress scenario: six intervals' coverage of the expected-row-sum target (target run, tag 'target'); qualification: lower-tail error (lower > target - 2.0 SE) of the two bootstrap-t intervals of both contrasts, each upper bound <= 0.07 at alpha 0.05/36 (purchase); upper-tail error likewise (upper-bound labels only)
effective.decision: unresolved_validity > correction_detected > none_detectable_provisional > unresolved; upper-bound codes are provisional until the power gate and the upper-tail coverage qualification pass
effective.estimand: every learned or calibrated C is a ratio of expected row sums; no mean of replicate ratios
effective.failure_wording: The registered two-comparator decision did not meet its power qualification under this alternative; it does not establish absence of a K+F correction.
effective.gates: power: lower Bonferroni CP bound >= 0.8 for 'correction detected' (alternative); linear-signal / ridge-bias stress scenario: five rates (C_WM and C_WM,S conditional / joint lower > 0, detected) each with upper bound <= 0.07 as operational safety requirements, not type-I size certification; one-sided alpha 0.05/36 = 0.00138889 each; invalid replicates count as failures / rejections with the planned denominator
effective.gauge_audit: F5 pins (F12a.2(i)): every fitted WM-R model, each seed and each outer fold, predicts every held-out row from its frozen and its gauge-transformed tokens (scripts/f12_gauge_tokens.py); |delta f| <= 1e-5 + 1e-4 |f| nats per row, f the seed's head prediction in nats; every nonzero discrepancy retained; any violation makes C_WM and C_WM,S undefined and the replicate unresolved (validity), counted as a failure (F12a.5(d)); not run on synthetic tokens without gauge tokens
effective.h_star: untrained WM-R head under torch.manual_seed(seed('20261111:f12:','hstar:<r>')), zero-edit subtracted, / its population SD over S_k; SD <= 1e-12 fails qualification
effective.intervals: A5.4.2 conditional + joint bootstrap-t, BCa and percentile, 4000 draws, PCG64(20261107) multiplicities shared by both contrasts; all guards; all draws valid
effective.joint_studentiser: max(V_comp + V_item - V_both, V_comp) at the point and in every joint draw (C_WM and C_WM,S only); a draw or the point is invalid if V_comp is non-finite or <= 0 or any term is non-finite (never replaced); strict and one-way-max rules reported on the identical draws
effective.noise: f12a: per simulated component one integers(0, 63) payload component; its rows by ascending id take choice(n_c, m, replace=m > n_c) donors sorted by id; one common integers(0, 32, size=32) block index for the panel; restricted payload copy only, byte-pinned
effective.outer_folds: 5; stratum = family or mixed; sha256('20261111:f12:'+id) within stratum; strata abliteration, chain, lora_sft, mixed, random_dir; round-robin; recomputed per S_k
effective.population: S_k = existing + first k purchasable components by sha256('20261111:f12:purchase:'+id)
effective.release: 'numerical eligibility pending Board A acceptance': fail-closed execution validator; never purchase authority
effective.scenarios: null = linear-signal / ridge-bias stress scenario (gamma = 0; not a no-correction null for C_WM: ridge-1 shrinkage is learnable); alt = token-function alternative calibrated against F3 (oracle C = 0.15); null_var2 = variance-x2 stress scenario (descriptive)
effective.schedule: 10 alt per k (r = 3000 + 0..n-1); k: k = 145 only; panel seeds seed('20261111:f12:', '{tag}:{r}') with tag 'pilot'
